cc:Work.dc:description: Source: tables/historical_metrics.csv; tables/v2_metrics.csv. Condition: Time-25, one development defect. Model: Two environments; no cross-environment frontier. Budget: See labeled arms. Verification tokens: provider input plus output; replay has no fresh inference. V1 budgets and V2 architecture differ; plotted comparisons are observational. No Qwen evidence-mixed frontier is claimed.
